items.author: Trump
items.text: The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage - The concept of which we are open to. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称伊朗'急切想达成协议'，暗示中东局势可能缓和，影响油价及金风科技等能源相关持仓。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise! The World’s Diesel price rise is mostly caused by the Russia/Ukraine War, not Iran. President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称乌俄互不打击对方能源目标，柴油价格上涨主因俄乌战争而非伊朗，关乎全球能源价格预期。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Iranians Are Running Out of Gas as Economic Squeeze Takes Hold: https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/iranians-are-running-out-of-gas-as-economic-squeeze-takes-hold-67e38a7b
items.summary_cn: 特朗普转发WSJ报道称伊朗'油尽气穷'，经济承压，暗示对伊施压或进一步升级，影响油气板块。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The only control or “guardrails” that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades! The Trump Administration has stopped AI “people” from doing bad, or potentially bad, “things,“ like Dario (Anthropic!), who is now pretending to be a “perfect little angel” - and we will continue to do so! We already have tremendous CRIMINAL and REGULATORY power over these companies! There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China. WHOEVER WINS AI, WINS! We are leading China, and all others, and will con
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称无需对AI加额外监管只需强势总统，抨击Anthropic，表态'谁赢得AI谁就赢'，暗示对中国AI竞争的战略紧迫感。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The only reason the AI/Data Center outburst is happening is because the United States is leading, by a lot, every other country. Don’t kill the Golden Goose! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普为美国AI/数据中心繁荣背书，反对监管扼杀，明确表态'AI赢家通吃'，利好AI与数据中心基建主题。

items.author: Burry
items.text: 'Big Short' Michael Burry says AI leaders' calls for slowdown are 'self-serving' and he's not worried
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry称AI领头羊呼吁'放缓AI'是'自私的'，他本人并不担忧，暗示AI泡沫论站不住脚。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Sends Fresh Warning to OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry向OpenAI与Anthropic发出新警告，对AI龙头估值/前景表达担忧。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 【金價走勢】花旗料金價重返5000美元潛在升幅15% 高盛籲4000美元收集迎新牛市
items.summary_cn: 据报道，花旗看高金价至5000美元（潜在升幅15%），高盛建议4000美元收集，金价新一轮牛市预期升温。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I’ve just received a Report that the United States is producing more Exquisite and Elite Weapons than at any time in our History. They are being delivered on a daily basis to our Forces in the Middle East, and beyond. Our Defense Company Factories are moving 24/7, while at the same time building, on average, 4 to 5 largescale brand new Plants, each! A primary focus of this production has been Patriots, THAAD Systems, Tomahawks, and other Standard Missile Systems, of which we already have large numbers in stock. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称美国国防工厂24/7满负荷运转，Patriots、THAAD、Tomahawk等导弹系统为重点增产对象，利好国防军工板块。

items.summary_cn: 据报道，洪灝讨论达里奥'重拳砸盘'及AI发展进入新阶段，宏观/AI主题信号。
